'''Uprooting Seedot''' (Japanese: '''VS タネボー''' ''VS Seedot''), titled '''VS Seedot''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 427th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 11th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}.

It is subtitled '''Jamming''' (Japanese: '''妨害の電波''' ''Jamming Waves'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Jamming Signals''' in the Chuang Yi translation.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
[[Palmer]] and [[Argenta]] are investigating the communication systems, alongside [[Riley]]. After discovering that [[Thorton]]'s analyzing device didn't cause the breakdown in the system, Palmer asks Riley what he thinks. Riley claims to feel an [[Aura]] coming from somewhere outside the [[Battle facility|facility]], comparing it to the [[Spear Pillar]].

Meanwhile, {{adv|Platinum}} is continuing her challenge of the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}. Using {{m|Toxic Spikes}} and {{m|Pin Missile}}, she defeats a {{p|Kadabra}} and then {{status|poison}}s the {{p|Seedot}} that switches in. The poisoning causes the Seedot to faint, making Platinum the winner of the match. The [[Battle Arcade]] announcer appears and reveals that [[Dahlia]] is currently in training since she lost, as it was the first time she lost since the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}} opened. Thorton suddenly buzzes, startling the speakers, and begins to watch Platinum. She is currently choosing what Pokémon she would like to trade. Thorton explains the trading system while Platinum decides to finally trade her {{p|Grimer}} for a {{p|Kadabra}}. Thorton claims that the most important part of challenging the Battle Factory is knowledge, both of your own Pokémon and your opponent's for trading.

In Platinum's 14th battle, she is using a {{p|Qwilfish}} against a {{p|Porygon}}, and defeats it using {{m|Destiny Bond}}. She is one set away from her battle against Thorton. Argenta and Palmer walk by, discussing the communications system, when they are stopped by watching Platinum battle. She finishes her final set and, confused, looks around for Thorton. Suddenly, she jumps at a loud buzz behind her, which is Thorton holding his machine. He claims that her team is 93%, but won't reveal what that number means. After the guide confirms that he must use [[rental Pokémon]] as well, the match starts.

In the first match, Platinum uses {{p|Loudred}} and Thorton uses {{p|Tyranitar}}. Loudred uses {{m|Stomp}}, but is overpowered by Tyranitar and thrown backwards. After more fighting, Loudred uses {{m|Roar}}, sending Tyranitar back and replacing it with {{p|Ledian}}. Thorton, angered, commands Ledian to use {{m|Supersonic}}, but Loudred is unaffected due to its {{a|Soundproof}} [[Ability]]. Thorton asks Platinum what all the sound-based moves are and she rattles every one off, to his surprise. He then uses {{m|Focus Punch}}, knocking out Loudred and switching back to Tyranitar. Platinum sends out Kadabra, and uses {{m|Psycho Cut}}, making Thorton laugh and remind Platinum that Psychic moves don't affect {{type|Dark}} Pokémon. Platinum replies that Kadabra also used {{m|Miracle Eye}}, making Tyranitar susceptible to all moves.
